title: Databricks performance checklist
summary: Begin with the query plan, scan size and task distribution before changing cluster size.

blocks.text: Begin with the query plan, scan size and task distribution before changing cluster size.

items: Check file pruning and partition/data-skipping behavior.
Use Photon/vectorized execution where available and suitable, but still fix avoidable scans/shuffles.
Autoscaling changes resource supply, not inefficient data layout or query semantics.
